column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-11 test-surface join.
# `development_plan_standards.md` section S clause 2 requires the run to enumerate its test
# surfaces and join them completely to an independently authored expectation. The surface
# names in the first column are the phase's own vocabulary, unchanged from the pre-amendment
# enumeration; what is new is that each one now names the run-time observations it stands on.
# The ids are read off the Phase-11 contract's Gate paragraph — the metrics that paragraph
# obliges the suite to record and the renderer mutants it names — not off any implementation
# output. They are joined at run time against the metric keys `formal-model-spec` actually
# wrote and the mutant files actually present, so a suite that quietly stops recording a
# metric, or a mutant that is deleted, breaks the join.
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   mutants   the renderer mutant descriptors under test/mutant/formal/
#   checks    the check ids tools/formal_model_kernel_gate.py implements
# A surface with no ids is one this register cannot reach. It is listed so the ledger can
# carry it as UNVERIFIED rather than omit it.
